PROGRAM
  MAPPING
    MAPPING_HEADER
      IDENT "Users"
      SHAPE_SEP ":"
      SHAPE_EXPR
        IDENT "Person"
      KW_FROM "from"
      EXPR
        LITERAL_EXPR
          IDENT "User"
    MAPPING_BODY
      PROPERTY
        PROPERTY_LHS
          AT_ATTR "@subject"
        ASSIGN "="
        EXPR
          BINARY_EXPR
            LITERAL_EXPR
              IDENT "a"
            KW_OR "or"
            BINARY_EXPR
              LITERAL_EXPR
                IDENT "b"
              KW_AND "and"
              BINARY_EXPR
                LITERAL_EXPR
                  IDENT "c"
                EQ "=="
                BINARY_EXPR
                  LITERAL_EXPR
                    IDENT "d"
                  PLUS "+"
                  BINARY_EXPR
                    LITERAL_EXPR
                      IDENT "e"
                    STAR "*"
                    LITERAL_EXPR
                      IDENT "f"
